Title: Pending customer updates list shows QAL Number, Customer Name and Details
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates.

Step Action: Look at the first column heading of the table.
Step Expected: The column heading QAL Number is shown.

Step Action: Look at the second and third column headings of the table.
Step Expected: The column headings Customer Name and Details are shown.

Step Action: Count the data rows in the table.
Step Expected: At least one data row is shown, with a QAL Number, a Customer Name and a Details link.

Title: Pending customer update details show Approve, Decline and Cancel and Cancel changes nothing
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates and at least one row is shown.

Step Action: Note the QAL Number and Customer Name of the first row as <first QAL number> and <first customer name>.
Step Expected: The two values are recorded.

Step Action: Select the Details link on the first row.
Step Expected: The page PendingCustomerUpdateDetails.aspx opens and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look at the buttons on the page without selecting Approve or Decline.
Step Expected: The buttons Approve, Decline and Cancel are visible.

Step Action: Select Cancel.
Step Expected: The page returns to the Review Pending Customer Updates list.

Step Action: Look for the row with <first QAL number> and <first customer name>.
Step Expected: The row is still listed, so nothing was approved or declined.

Title: Pending participant updates page opens with its heading
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates.

Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingParticipantUpdates.aspx.
Step Expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Participant Updates.

Step Action: Look at the content under the heading.
Step Expected: Either a table of pending participants or the message There are no pending participants to display. is shown.

Step Action: If no pending participants are listed, read the message.
Step Expected: The message reads There are no pending participants to display.

Title: Admin approves and declines pending customer updates
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/Contracts Admin/ReviewPendingCustomerUpdates.aspx as a signed-in Admin.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Review Pending Customer Updates and at least two rows are shown.

Step Action: Note the QAL Number of the first row as <approve QAL number> and of the second row as <decline QAL number>.
Step Expected: The two QAL Numbers are recorded.

Step Action: Select Details on the row for <approve QAL number>, then select Approve.
Step Expected: <outcome message after Approve> is shown and the page leaves the details view.

Step Action: Check the Review Pending Customer Updates list.
Step Expected: The row for <approve QAL number> is no longer listed.

Step Action: Select Details on the row for <decline QAL number>, then select Decline.
Step Expected: <outcome message after Decline> is shown and the page leaves the details view.

Step Action: Check the Review Pending Customer Updates list.
Step Expected: The row for <decline QAL number> is no longer listed.

Step Action: Cleanup: ask the environment owner to reset the seed data.
Step Expected: Both pending customer updates are listed again after the reset.
